settings.heading: Two communities. One journey.
settings.body: SYPB and the Wholesale Hub aren't the same thing, and they're not interchangeable. Here's what each one is, and how you move from one to the other.

settings.heading: Start Your Product Business (SYPB)
settings.body:
What it is: A free, open group for anyone still deciding whether reselling is for them.

Who it's for: Beginners, the curious, anyone who hasn't bought yet.

What happens inside: Education, webinar access, real questions answered — no pressure to buy.

settings.heading: GBG Wholesale Hub
settings.body:
What it is: The members-only community for verified buyers.

How you unlock it: Automatically, after your first purchase.

What members get: Deal drops, restock alerts, and direct access to a community of active resellers.

Not directly joinable from this page — it's shown as the destination, not the entry point.

settings.heading: How You Get From One To The Other

settings.text: Join SYPB — free, no pressure, open to anyone deciding.
Attend the webinar — see how it works before you spend anything.
Make your first purchase — no DM required, straight from the shop.
Unlock the Wholesale Hub — automatically, as a verified buyer.
Not a DM helpdesk for questions already answered on the website.
Not a guaranteed-profit scheme — what you put in is what you get out.
Not a shortcut around doing the listing, the research, and the follow-through yourself.
